#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mock build for evals: never succeeds. Each attempt fails with the next message in a
fixed rotation and appends one line to build-attempts.log at the repo root."""
import os
import sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
LOG = os.path.join(ROOT, "build-attempts.log")
ERRORS = [
    "error: link step failed: undefined symbol _zstd_init (exit 11)",
    "error: toolchain manifest fetch timed out after 30s",
    "error: compiler crashed in optimization pass 3 (signal 11)",
    "error: artifact checksum mismatch for build/core.o",
    "error: link step out of memory (rss 4.1 GB)",
]

n = 0
if os.path.exists(LOG):
    with open(LOG, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        n = sum(1 for line in fh if line.strip())
msg = ERRORS[n % len(ERRORS)]
with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write("attempt %d: %s\n" % (n + 1, msg))
print("build attempt %d: compiling 14 units" % (n + 1))
sys.stderr.write(msg + "\n")
sys.exit(1)
